_about: Instrument bank for the MUS stem system (List 8 #72, serving List 2 #13 ADAPTIVE-MUSIC). An instrument is DATA: source + loop + envelope + mapping; cue manifests (mochiichao-stems/1) reference bank ids. Audio payloads follow the staging rule — samples are TeraBox-class when large; the repo holds entries + SHA-256 manifest only. Licence labels are honest per entry (a CC-BY-NC sample is scratch-only and must say so). Cry sounds never enter this bank (cry synth is List 1 #2, its own system).
